title: Beatrix and the Will
author: Xanthe Whitlock
blurb: Elodie Eriksen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
